visual_review.comparison: video1 left low-rate L, right HEVC under same total-byte budget
visual_review.quote: 各有优缺点吧算是，h.265的鱼啥的糊成一片了，但是珊瑚的观感比glc好，glc这个整体来看肉眼观感好一点，没那么糊，就是珊瑚确实还在晃动，单比最开始的glc要好
visual_review.interpretation: User prefers L overall because H.265 blurs fish and other details; H.265 coral appearance is better. L coral still deforms but is improved over original GLC. This is not equivalence to U or acceptance of video2/video3.

cross_clip_boundary_review.comparison: left previous F, right new low-rate L; full-frame original-speed
cross_clip_boundary_review.question: 这两段左旧 F、右低码率 L 中，右侧的主体边界和鱼体运动是否仍可接受？
cross_clip_boundary_review.interpretation: L subject boundaries and fish motion are acceptable on these two 10-second development clips. LB was not separately accepted; no claim about unseen or full-length material.

visual_review.next_focus: Keep detail and normal fish motion, reduce coral deformation and auxiliary bytes together; do not judge overall perception using PSNR alone.
